title: Diagnostics
description: Records CPU, memory and disk during a slowdown and analyses the measurements on this device. Keeps up to 30 recordings, which you can export or delete.
localFirst: Start recording, then reproduce the slowdown: CPU, memory and disk are sampled on this device only.
collectProcesses: Include top processes (names stay on this device)
name: Name
deleteDescription: The recording and its reports are deleted from this device. This cannot be undone; a JSON export you already saved is kept.
exportPrivacy: Exported JSON is not encrypted and may include collected process names.
operationFailed: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
evidenceLimit: First 50 measurements in the selected interval
discardTitle: Discard the unsaved name and notes?
discardDescription: Your changes to this recording's name and notes are lost.
recordingSaved: Recording saved. Choose Analyze recording to generate a local report.
stopBeforeDetails: You can draft a name and notes while recording. Choose Stop and save first, then Save details. Your draft will be kept.
unsavedDetails: You have unsaved details. Save them before exporting or selecting another recording.
nameRequired: Enter a name for this recording.
capacityReached: All 30 recording slots are in use. Unpin and delete an old recording to make room.
analysisDescription: Review sustained CPU and memory load, peaks, disk transfers and gaps in the saved measurements.
analysisSaved: Local report saved with this recording. Your draft details have been kept.
analysisPrivacy: Runs entirely on this device, without AI or sending data. The report stays in the encrypted recording and is included when you export it.
stopBeforeAnalysis: Choose Stop and save first, then Analyze recording. Recording and report stay on this device.
localReportCaution: Local analysis · Confidence refers to observations, not to the cause of a slowdown
aiDescription: Ask Codex to interpret the saved measurements and suggest what to inspect next.
aiPrivacy: Only numeric measurements and random process references are sent to Codex. File contents are never read or sent. Recording names, notes, process names, paths, commands, hostnames, and process IDs stay on this device. Process names in the report are matched locally after the response.
aiAccess: Uses your existing Codex sign-in. Analysis starts only when you choose Run.
aiStopFirst: Stop and save the recording before running Codex analysis.
aiBackground: Analysis continues if you leave this page. Return to this recording to see the result.
aiAnalysisSaved: Codex report saved with this recording. Your draft details have been kept.
aiReportCaution: Codex analysis · Confidence describes evidence, not a confirmed cause

aiErrors.codex-not-found: Codex is not installed. Install it, then check again.
aiErrors.codex-version-unsupported: This Codex version is unsupported. Use the supported version 0.157.1, then check again.
aiErrors.not-connected: Sign in to your existing Codex account, then check again.
aiErrors.codex-unavailable: Codex is unavailable. Check the connection and try again.
aiErrors.unsafe-configuration: Codex is configured in a way that cannot protect this request. Check its configuration before retrying.
aiErrors.busy: Codex is already analyzing another request. Wait for it to finish, then retry.
aiErrors.cancelled: Analysis cancelled. The previous report is still available.
aiErrors.timeout: Codex did not respond in time. Try again.
aiErrors.invalid-metadata: This recording could not be prepared for analysis.
aiErrors.invalid-response: Codex returned a report that could not be verified. Try again.
aiErrors.analysis-failed: Codex analysis could not be completed. Try again.
